summary: Iteration 6 — Backend 4/4 PASS against live https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (POST /api/register with unique email → 200 with {token,user, push_notifications_enabled:false default}; PUT /api/me/preferences {push_notifications_enabled:true} → 200 and GET /api/me confirms persistence; PUT preferences with push false also persists; shared account login still returns 200). Frontend E2E (Expo web @ 390x844, base https://bill-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com) 100% PASS: (1) Root routing — after clearing storage, '/' redirects to /splash; splash-slide-0/1/2 render; splash-next advances slides, on last slide label becomes 'Get started' and navigates to /landing; uch_seen_splash localStorage flag is set to 'true'; re-visiting '/' now lands on /landing (not /splash). (2) Landing — landing-title, landing-feature-0/1/2, landing-create-account, landing-signin all render; landing-signin → /signin (signin-title); landing-create-account → /signup (signup-header). (3) Sign-up flow — completed step1 (unique e2e_signup2_1786968872@example.com / Password123!) → step2 (limited_company chip + signup-company-input) → signup-submit lands on push-primer-title; push-primer-enable fires PUT /api/me/preferences to the LIVE backend and navigates to /dashboard (dashboard-greeting visible). (4) Help/Privacy/Terms from Profile — profile-help-link → help-header + help-section-0..3; profile-privacy-link → privacy-header + privacy-full-link; profile-terms-link → terms-header + terms-full-link; back navigation returns to Profile. (5) Regression — signout returns to /signin (signin-title); existing shared account (e2e_test_1786703401@example.com) logs in and reaches dashboard-greeting; authed '/' redirects to /dashboard. Networking: 32/32 /api/* requests hit https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host (zero leaks to preview host). Prior HIGH-priority iteration_5 bug (quote contact prefill in /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx) is NOT re-verified in this iteration's scope but was NOT touched in the diff, so please check separately.

critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx routing logic is correct: waits for auth ready + seenSplash before Redirect; authed → /dashboard, first-time-unauthed → /splash, returning-unauthed → /landing.
splash.tsx persists uch_seen_splash before router.replace('/landing') on both splash-next (last slide) and splash-skip — matches spec.
landing.tsx wires create/signin CTAs to /signup and /signin correctly and renders landing-feature-0..2.

onboarding/push-primer.tsx correctly PUTs {email_notifications_enabled, push_notifications_enabled:true} to /me/preferences and always router.replaces to /dashboard (even on error) so the primer is non-blocking. Good.
help.tsx / privacy.tsx / terms.tsx use ScreenHeader with correct testIDs, use canGoBack fallback to /profile, and open external pricebuddy.co.uk URLs via Linking.openURL.
signup.tsx correctly redirects to /onboarding/push-primer after signUp() resolves (not straight to /dashboard) — matches spec.
All API calls resolve to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (verified: 32/32 requests went to https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host/api/*).
